file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for Newcastle University Medicine MBBS A100. This file preserves the approved Newcastle implementation specification, evidence model, implementation mapping and known review boundaries; executable rules live in data/universities/newcastle-a100.json and data/interview-band-configs/newcastle-a100.json.

manual_review_scope: non-exact UCAT totals outside the published table
research_scope.notes: The existing repository profile was an MSC seed with unknown rules. It has been replaced with the approved research-backed production profile.

evidence_classification_policy.official_policy: A rule or statistic attributed by the approved Newcastle specification to Newcastle University or an official public body.
evidence_classification_policy.official_threshold_document: A scoring or historical threshold attributed by the approved Newcastle specification to the Newcastle UCAT/academic threshold document.
evidence_classification_policy.historical_guidance: Cycle-labelled historical data used only to position competitiveness, never as a formal current minimum.
evidence_classification_policy.display_only_legacy_scale: A legacy 3600-scale UCAT figure shown on its original scale and never compared with a 2700-scale applicant score.
evidence_classification_policy.manual_review: Evidence exists but the generic engine should not automate the rule without route-specific confirmation.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: The supplied evidence does not establish the fact safely enough for execution.

metadata.repository_discrepancy_reported_before_e: Existing Newcastle A100 production JSON was a low-confidence MSC seed with unknown GCSE, A-level, UCAT and selection rules.

route_limited_blockers: No rounding rule is supplied for UCAT totals that do not appear in the exact official table.
Historical International UCAT thresholds are on the legacy 3600 scale and are display-only.
Country-specific qualification mappings require Newcastle A100-specific official confirmation before automated hard rules.
Post-interview offer selection is reference-only and is not used by ApplySmart.

steps: Check academic eligibility for the applicant route.
Require current-cycle UCAT and reject SJT Band 4.
For Home, Contextual, PARTNERS and Graduate A100 applicants, calculate academic score out of 40 plus UCAT table score out of 60.
For International applicants, perform academic pass/fail screening and rank by UCAT cognitive total only.
Show historical data by applicant pool and scale without treating historical observations as formal minima.

manual_review_boundaries: International country-level qualification rules are official-country-lookup or manual-review only.
Access to HE requires course preapproval, Medicine QAA descriptor and years-out-of-formal-education checks.
Irish Leaving Certificate automation is not fully implemented by the generic classifier.
No cross-scale UCAT conversion is allowed.
Non-exact UCAT scores are not rounded or interpolated.
